title: L6 Code Search: Full Reconnaissance Codebase Map
description: Probes full reconnaissance synthesis. The scout must explore the multi-file, multi-language base_tooling_workspace and emit a single structured JSON codebase map with architecture, modules (name/purpose/dependencies), entry_points, and data_flow. The output must be valid JSON grounded in real reads of the fixture files (server.py, config.py, backend/api.py, src/utils/helpers.py).
prompt: Perform full reconnaissance of this workspace and produce a single JSON codebase map of the form {"architecture": string, "modules": [{"name": string, "purpose": string, "dependencies": [string]}], "entry_points": [string], "data_flow": string}. Ground every entry in files you actually read; include server.py among the entry_points. Return only the JSON object. 你必须使用工作区的只读检索工具（如 repo_rg / repo_tree / read_file）进行实际侦察，并严格基于工具返回的结果作答；禁止仅凭假设或上下文直接作答。 在 entry_points 中必须给出每个入口的真实入口函数名（需读取源码确认，例如 server.py 的入口函数）。
